3. Ukusalanganishiwa ukwa Imisango nangu Imitundu iya Suminishiwa mu Incende iya Imisumba iya Imiputule iya Luapula na Northern
Ukutantikwa ukwa imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi pe samba eyasuminishiwa ukusungwa nangu ukutekwa mu imisumba iyalekana lekana iya imiputule iya Luapula na Northern.

Umutundu uwe sabi Ishina lya Cikaya Incende nangu imisumba Oreochromis Pale, Inkamba, Chambo Imisumba yonse mu muputule Macrochir (Green- uwa Luapula ilyo mu Northern headed bream) kufumyako imisumba iya Mpulungu,Mbala na Nsama. Coptodon Rendalli Impende, Pende, Mbufu Imisumba yonse mu muputule (Red-breasted bream) uwa Luapula ilyo mu Northern kufumyako imisumba iya Mpulungu,Mbala na Nsama. Oreochromis Tanganicae Impende Isangwafye mu umuputule uwa (Tanganyika bream) Northern na imisumba iya Mpulungu, Mbala na Nsama. Clarius Gariepinus Imilonge, Lindombe, Mu- Mu imiputule yonse ibili iya (Catfish) lamba Luapula na Northern.
Ngacakuti ndefwaya ukulasunga nangu ukulateeka isabi nangu imisango imbi iipya, mulandu nshi nshinga suminishiwa?

Kwaliba imilandu iyingi iicingilisha ifi. Ica kubalilapofye li funde (Fisheries Act ilya ukulenga 22 ilya mu 2011), umo abalimi nangu abasunga isabi, basuminishiwafye ukusunga imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi likaya ilisangwa mu incende isho. Ukubika nangu ukutendeka na imisango iipya iya Tilapia muli ifi ifishiba nangu imimana kuti kwaleta amasakamiko ayakalamba ayo ayengonaula imisango imbi iya cikaya muli iyi imimana nangu ifishiba. Nga icilangililo, ilyo imisango ipya nangu iyeni iya isabi yaletwa nangu ukusokololwa muli iyi imimana nangu ifishiba, ici kuti calenga ukusandana ukwa imisango nangu imitundu iya cikaya abekashi ba isho incende bashintililapo, ukubwelela pe samba ku milandu:
Imisango nangu imitundu iipya iyo iingaletwa muli isho incende kuti nomba yalacimfyanya na iine iya cikaya mufya kulya na umwakwikala:
2. Ukulakumana pakati aka imisango nangu imitundu iipya na iya cikaya kuti nomba kwabapo na ukutinya ukonaula apakalamba ubukankala ubwa imbuto nangu isabi ilya cikaya.

Ukuya kulasandana bwangu ukwa isabi mu mumana uwa Kafue kwa isaba nkuma na ukonaika ukwa inika iya Kafue Flats Fishery (source (intulo) Kafue River Trust http://www.kafuerivertrust.org/ invasive-alien-species/).

Kuti na esha ukutungulula ukusandana ukwa iyi imisango nangu imitundu iipya mu ifishiba fyandi, eico tekuti kwingaba nangu kumo ukusakamana ukwa ukusankanya iyi imisango na imisango iya isabi ilya cikaya.

Kulaba ukusakamana inshita yonse ukwa ukutila isabi kuti lya fuma. Nga icilangililo, musango uwa isabi ilya letelwe mu ifishiba ifya mumana uwa Kafue pakati aka imyaka iya 1982 ukufika ku 1988. Isabi limo lyali fumine muli ifi ifishiba na ukutendeka ukulasandana na isabi ilya cikaya mu ululamba ulwa umumana wa Kafue. Abalondo aba isabi mu umumana uwa Kafue nomba basosa ukutila isabi ilingi bekata lya Nile Tilapia ukucila
pa ilya cikaya ilya Three-spot na Green-headed bream (Source [intulo] Kafue River Trust http://www. kafuerivertrust.org/invasive-alien-species/). Isabi ilya cikaya lyena nomba lileya lilecepelako.
Mu icintubwingi njikalila, cintu icakosa apakalamba ukusanga imbuto iya isabi. Ngacakutila ndefwaya ukushita imbuto ukufuma ku umusumba umbi, fintu nshi ninga cita?

Insambu ukufuma ku ciputulwa ica Department of Fisheries (DoF) ilafwaikwa pa ukusesha nangu ukutwala isabi ilituntulu ukufuma ku cifulo cimo ukuya kuli cimbi. Imyenseshe iya isabi pakati aka imisumba mu ukuya lisungila mu ifishiba fimbi, kufwile ukucitwafye panuma iyakupoka insambu ukupitila mu mapepala ayalembwa ukufuma ku babomfi aba mu DoF abangalila nangu ukulolesha pa imisungile iya isabi na abalimi banono. Ici cikankala apakalamba pa mulandu uwakutila muli iyi inshila kuti kwaba ukusungilila imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi ilya cikaya ilyo ilyaba mu ifishiba nangu amenshi aya kuli iyo incende.
Bushe kuti naishiba shani ukutila umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ndefwaya euyo uwingayana nangu ukulinga na incende nabelako?
Pa umulandu uwa ifilondolwelwe kale, isabi ilya cikaya elya seka na ukutemwikwa. Ipusheni nangu ukulanshanya na aba mu ciputulwa ica DoF, ngacakutila muli na amasakamiko nangu ukutwishika.

• Nga cakutila mulefwaya ukulasunga isabi ilya ukushitisha, tala moneni nangu ukufwailisha ngacakutila uyo umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi mulefwaya ulakabilwa nangu ukufwaikwa apakalamba uko konse muli na ukulatwala.
Bushe fintu nshi fimbi mfwile naloleshapo nangu ukufwailisha ilyo ndefwaya ukusala umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ndefwaya ukula sunga?
Lolekesheni pa inshita iya imikulile iya umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi. Nga cakuti mulefwaya ukuiposa mu ukuteka isabi ilya ukushitisha, umusango nangu umutundu ufwile ukuba ni uyo uukula bwangu;

• Umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ufwile ukuba ni uyo uupilibula bwangu ifilyo ifya isabi pa ukulasangamo ifya ukulya (ifyo ifipangwa mu bwingi ubwa fiko na ukula shitishiwa nangu ifipangwafye pa mayanda);

• Umusango nangu umutundu uwe sabi ufwile ukuba ni uyo uusanga bwangu ifya ukulya mu icishiba lisungilwa, nga icilangililo ‘plankton’, iyo iyaba icakulya icisangwa pa inshita iya ukubika umufundo mu cishiba mwine;
Tontonkanyeni apakalamba pa ukusunga isabi ilya kunkuma nangu ukukosa ku amalwele ayengi;
• Nga cakutila musunga isabi ilya imisango nangu imitundu iyalekana lekana mu icishiba cimo cine, moneni ukutila mwasala ilishilya isabi libiye. Pamo nga icilangililo, imilonge ilalya isabi limbi;
• Moneni ukutila mwa tontonkanishisha pa ukufwaya nangu ukusanga imbuto iisuma iya ukupyanikisha pa iilefumapo.

4. Ukusala Incende apa Ukwimbila Icishiba ica Isabi
Pa ukusala incende apa ukwimbila icishiba, tala tontonkanyeni pali ifi ifyakonkapo:

Ukwa ukufumya amenshi ukwacetekelwa: Intulo iya amenshi ifwile ukuba iya umwaka onse kabili iishinga kwata finkolwa nkolwa ifili fyonse. Nga cingayana, intulo iya amenshi ifwile ukuba iya imako nangu ku mulundu panono pakutila kwaba ukucefyanyako indalama isha ukuposa pa ukula pompela amenshi aya ukulaisusha icishiba ico ayene kuti yale pongolokelamofye.

Umusango ufwile ukubelamo amenshi: Icikabilila nangu ukutalala ukwa amenshi kufwile ukuba ukwayana na umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ilili na ukula sungwamo. Umusango nangu umutundu uwa Tilapia, wena ukula bwino mu menshi ayaba pakati aka 24C na 32C. Impende (Tanganyika Bream), shena tashikula bwino mu menshi ayatalala.

Esheni ukufwaya incende iya icikabilila apo mwingembila icishiba cakusungilamo isabi elyo kabili iyi incende ipalamana na ifimuti nangu ifimpukusa, ifyo fingala cingilisha amenshi ku kasuba na ukubwesesha panshi icikabilila ica amenshi. Tilapia isandana bwino, mu ifishiba ifya pa mbilibili umo amenshi yaba cila inshita aya cikabilila.
Pa ukusunga icishiba cenu ica amenshi aya cikabilila citeni ifi ifya konkapo:
Sungeni amenshi mu cishiba ayashili ayakwenda nangu ukulasuma;
Lundenipo amenshi ayashabikwamo ifili fyonse ngacakutila yabwelela pe samba ilya 15 cm nangu ukucilapo;

• Ukushika ukwa icishiba kufwile ukuba 1 m. Ukushika nangu ukwimba ukwa icishiba kufwile ukuba pakati aka 1.2 - 1.3 m kwi samba ilyo ku mulundu kufwile ukuba pakati aka 0.6 - 0.8 m ukulinganafye na ubukulu ubwa icishiba. Ifishiba ifikalamba nafyo fimbwa nangu ukupangwa mu inshila imo ine ukulingafye na ubukulu ubwa fiko.
• Mulandu nshi mufwile mwaleukila icishiba cenu icisha shika ukufikapo: Amenshi ayashaya patali yalaluka inshita ishingi ukulingana na ifili inshita nangu ubushiku;
• Ifishiba ifisha shika filenga ifyuni ifikalamba pamo nga ‘ama Marabou’ ukulaikata na ukulya isabi. Ifishiba ifya fikapo mu ukushika, filenga isabi ukulasanga umwa ukufisama ilyo lya sanswa;

Icishibisho ku basunga amani: Ifishiba ifisha shika kuti fya bomba bwino mu uku totesha amani aya isabi. Ifishiba ifisha shika filenga amenshi ukuba aya cikabilila. Ni ici icikabilila iciwamina ukukula ukwa isabi.

• Mu ukusandana ukwa amani ukucilisha mu incende isha ‘hapa-based hatchery’. TE CAKWESHA ukubomfya ifishiba ifisha shika. Ilyo kwaba ukupekanya bwino bwino, ama ‘hapa’ tayafwile ukwikala nangu ukubela panshi nangu pe samba ilya icishiba. Ama ‘hapa’ yafwile ukupekanishiwa ukufuma panshi aya icishiba 10 - 15 ama senti mita ‘cm’. Ifishiba ifya shika filenga ukutila ama ‘hapa’ yakwate amenshi ayalinga kabili na pe samba napo apasuma.Apo casangwa ukuyana na incende iya impanga, pangeni icishiba icingakwata incende isha suluka; Icikabilila ica amenshi cili na ukuba ica cila mu mbali ukucila pa incende shimbi pa umulandu uwa ukusuluka na ukubela pa mulu.

• Apo casangwa ukuyana na incende iya impanga, pangeni icishiba icingakwata incende isha suluka; Icikabilila ica amenshi cili na ukuba ica cila mu mbali ukucila pa incende shimbi pa umulandu uwa ukusuluka na ukubela pa mulu.

Umusango uwa umushili uwayana: Icishiba cifwile ukukwata umushili uwa ibumba ico umushili uwa ibumba kuti waikata amenshi. Umushili uwa mucanga mucanga tawa wama pantu imbali isha icishiba kuti shilelikwa mu ukwa ngufyanya, na ukuleka amenshi ukulasuma.
Saleni incende iyasuluka bwino: Pangeni icishiba pa incende nangu impanga iyasuluka bwino bwino apo cingala anguka ukwisusha na ukufumya amenshi bwino mu inshita iya kula pompelamo nangu
ukupompa pa ukufumya. Incende isha sulukisha ta shayana nangu ukulinga ku fishiba pantu umushili ulasendwa bwangu.

Incende iya cifulo ica cishiba ifwile ukuba iya anguka ukufikako: Na abene abalimi ukufuma pa ng’anda mukwangukilwa ukwangalila icishiba (pamo nga ukulisha na cila inshita ukumona ifilecitika ku isabi) elyofye na ukula lisopa. Kabili icishiba cine cifwile ca angukilwa ukufikako mu ukubomfya imisebo iya ukucisuntinkanya na ku fisankano nangu imishika pamofye na ukulatwalako ifilefwaikwa.

Saleni incende isho ishi shi bunda: Ici cilafwa apakalamba ukucefya ukuposa indalama ishingi pa ukulapyanikishapo isabi ilyo ilingalasendwa na amenshi panuma iya ukubunda. Ukuleuka impanga iibunda kabili kwafwilisha amenshi aya mu cishiba ukukana suntinkana na amenshi ayamu mushili.
Ine ndi mulimi umupya elyo kuti natemwa ukuiposa mu bulimi ubwa isabi. Fintu nshi ninga cita?

Ukucingilila ukucita ifilubo na amasakamiko yambi aya ku ntanshi, tandalileni iofeshi ilya aba bomfi ba mu ciputulwa ica DoF pa kuya mupandako amano aya ukusala icifulo icingalinga ukwimbilapo icishiba. Abalimi tabafwile ukuiposa mufya imilimo iya ukusunga isabi ukwabula ukwipusha nangu ukupoka amano ukufuma kuba buteeko ubwa cikaya pamofye naba bomfi aba mu ciputulwa ica DoF.
Ndefwaya ukuiposa mu ubulimi ubwa isabi, lelo incende yandi ya menshi menshi. Fintu nshi ninga cita?
Twapapata belengeni ipepala ilyo tupekenye mu ukwasuka ubwipusho bwenu.
Ni inshila nshi iya angukisha kabili iya ukuposapo indalama ishinono ninga bomfya pa ukumona nga cakuti umusango uwa umushili kuti walinga ku ukupanga icishiba?
Kwaliba inshila shitatu isho imwe mwinga bomfya:
1. Inshila iya ukutinika iloba:
a. Bomfyeni iloba ilya linga na amenshi pakutila lya bombafye ukulinga;
b. Tinikeni na amaaka ili iloba mu minwe yenu;
c. Ngacakutila lyashala nalikatana panuma iya ukwisula iminwe yenu, ninshi ili iloba lisuma ukupangilako icishiba;
2. Iloba mu mwela:
a. Bomfyeni iloba elyo na ukupanga nga umupila; b. Poseni mu mwela elyo kabili mu lyanke nangu ukulikata
c. Nga cakutila uyu umupila wa ikatana bwino bwino uwine, ninshi ili iloba lisuma uku pangilako icishiba;
d. Nga cakuti wa bongoloka nangu wa salangana, ninshi uyu umushili tauli uwa ukupangilako icishiba;
3. Ukwesha ifyo amenshi yengila mu mushili:
a. Imbeni icilindi icingalepa mita imo (1 m) mu mushili. Isusheni ici icilindi na amenshi ukufikafye napa milomo. Kupikeni pali ici icilindi na amabula;

b. Ubushiku ubwa konkapo amenshi mu cilindi yali na ukubwelela pe samba ku umulanduuwakutila ninshi umushili na onka amenshi. Isusheni kabili ici icilindi na amenshi ukufika pa milomo na uku kupikapo na amabula;

c. Ubushiku ubwakonkapo, lolesheni apa pelelele amenshi. Ngacakutila amenshi yacili na yesula, umushili ninshi untu walinga ukupangapo icishiba. Ngacakutila amenshi na yengila, ninshi tauli uwalinga ku cishiba ica ukutekelamo isabi.
5. Inshila Ishisuma isha Ukubombelamo mu Incende isha Nika Nika
Ukupanga icishiba cenu mu incende iya inika nika kwaba na ifya kusakamika ifingi. Nga icilangililo:

a) Muli na ukufilwa ukukamika amenshi mu cishiba cenu mu inshita iya ukusombola na ukuwamya ici icishiba. Cikankala apakalamba ukukamika icishiba conse pa ukusombola isabi lyonse ukucilisha nga mwaba mu umulimo uwa ukushitisha isabi nga ubukwebo;
b) Kuti mwa lusa isabi lyenu lyonse mu cishiba ilyo ca bunda sana sana mu inshita iya mainsa;
c) Ukupanga icishiba kuti kwa kosa apakalamba ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi mu inshita iya mainsa nangu incende intu yakwatisha amenshi;

d) Ukutungulula umusango uwa amenshi na ukwa ukuya nangu ukulola kulakosa, nga icilangililo ukukusha nangu ukufusha ifya ukulya ifya cikaya ifisangwafye mu ifishiba ifya uyu umusango (Plankton) kuli na ukuba ukwa kosa apakalamba ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi ukufuma mu mushili;
e) Natulanshanya kale pa amasakamiko yamo yamo aya incende ukubikapofye na ukwingililwa ukwa amenshi aya mu cishiba kuya kufumafye mukati aka umushili.
Lelo, ngacakutila mulefwaisha apakalamba ukupanga icishiba mu incende iya uyu umusango, kwaliba inshila shimo shimo umwa ukusengulwila aya amasakamiko ayaseeka:

Kusheni ubutali na ubukulu ubwa icibumbili ica icishiba pa ukucingilila ukwisulila na ukupala ukwa amenshi mu inshita iya amainsa, kabili ubukulu ubwa icishiba bubwesesha panuma nangu ukucingilila ukusuma ukwa amenshi ukufuma mu icishiba cimo ukuya muli cimbi;

• Ukubomfya imipaipi iya utunwa tukulu kuti kwa afwilisha apakalamba ukufumya amenshi ayacila mu cipimo; amenshi ayacila mu cipimo ngata yasempwilwe nangu ukufwampulwa, kuti yalenga nangu ukutwala ifibumbili ifya icishiba ku ukutobeka na ukubongoloka.
Pe samba ni inshila shimo ishayana apakalamba isho mwingakonka mu ukupanga na ukwangalila ifishiba mu incende isha nika nika nangu amenshi.
1. Incende ifwile ukukwata nangu ukuba iyacingililwa ku kweshiwa ukwa kuponenwa na ukubunda nangu ilyeshi mu inshita iya mainsa:

Ilyeshi ilyo ilipala na ukucisha mu ukwisula ukwa icishiba kutwala mu ukulufya ifya mweo ifisangwamo, ukwambukisha ifishiba na ifintu fimbi ifya kunse pamo penefye na amenshi ayakowela. Mu incende isha nika nika, ukweshiwa na ilyeshi kula cila apakalamba. Mufwile mwasala incende iyo iya kweshiwa na ilyeshi linga cepa. Ipusheni nangu fwa ilisheni ku balimi na abekashi bashinguluka iyo incende pa kwishibilapo ifingi pa mweo uwa iyo nika nika pa myaka isano iya pitapo ukulola ku kuponenwa na ilyeshi elyo napa umulandu uwa amenshi ukulasangwa.
2. Te cakwesha ukupanga icishiba pa intulo iya amenshi:
Akamfukumfuku entulo iya amenshi ukufuma mu mushili, elyo ya seka ukulasangwa mu incende isha nika nika. Imilandu ifishiba fishifwile kupangilwa pa tumfukumfuku yakutila:
a) Amenshi ayo ayapulamo yalashupa apakalamba umwa ukuyabomfesha nangu ukutwala;
b) Ifishiba kuti fyapala ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi;
c) Ukulufya isabi ku mulandu uwa ilyeshi;

d) Ifya ukufuma mu ifya ukulya ifya cishiba fili na ukuba ifya shupa ukusanga pa mulandu uwakutila ifintu ifyo fifumako fili na ukukosa ukufisanga ico amenshi yalepitililafye cila inshita. Lelo, bomfyeni amenshi aya mu kamfukumfuku pamo nga entuntuko ayakwingila mu icishiba. Mu ncende isha nika nika na amasakamiko aya kucepelwa na amenshi, icishiba ica ukusunga amenshi pa mbali kuti capangwa mupepifye na kamfukumfuku, umo ukufuma muli ici icishiba amenshi kuti nomba yaleya mu fishiba ifya isabi.
3. Incende shifwile ukucingililwa ku kubunda:

Ku umulandu uwakutila ukweshiwa mu kupalilwa amenshi ku kalamba, ifibumbili ifya fishiba fifwile ukusumbulwa nga cinganguka. Ifishiba fifwile ukukwata ifibumbili ifitali na imipaipi iya tunwa tukulu iya ukusuminisha umwa ukupalila amenshi ilyo ya isula. Mu inshita iya ukukwatafye inshila imo iya umupaipi uwa ukusumunwinamo amenshi nga yafulisha, ifishiba mu incende isha fulisha amenshi, kuti fyakwata imipaipi iyingi umwa ukufumisha amenshi.

4. Mwi panga ifishiba mu incende isha nika nika isho isha cingililwa nangu isha tefya:

Incende isha nika nika sha senda iciputulwa ica Zambia ica cetekelwa ukufika kuli 19%. Mwaba ifishiba ifya ipangafye ifline, ifya pangwa na abantu, imilonga iya amenshi, incende isha mishitu shisulila amenshi, ifiswebebe ifya nika nika na amalungu. Incende shimo isha tefwetefwe shaliba isha cindama apakalamba kunse iya icalo, pamofye nga ba bemba ba Bangweulu, Tanganyika na Mweru-wa-Ntipa, abasangwa mu imiputule iya Northern na Luapula mu Zambia, isho kabili ni incende ishikankala umo umwinga latekelwa isabi. Imilimo iya ubulimi ubwa ifitekwa na ifilimwa ifya mu menshi kufwile ukucitwa ukwabula ukufulunganya imibele iya ishi incende. Nga icilangililo, ukucingilila incende ku kankala apakalamba ukufwile ukucitwa mu ukusungilila ubukankala ubbwa amenshi na ifisangwa mu icishiba cine (moneni pa akapepala aka kulenga mutanda nangu [6] pa inshila isha ku bomfya muli uku ukucingilila). Inshila shimbi shaba:

a. Ukupanga ukwa ifishiba ifya ukusungilamo nangu ukulaposeshamo isabi kabili ifyo ifingalasunga amenshi ukufuma mu fishiba pakutila kuleba ukusunga ifilyo nangufye fyonse ifilesangwa nangu ifilefuma mu fishiba;
b. Ukubomfya umusango uwa isabi ilya cikaya, ilyo ilishingonaula imibele iya amenshi nangu impanga;
c. Talukeni nangu lambeni ku ukubomfya ifya imiti miti, ifyo ifingalamfya ifishiba ifisunga amenshi.
6. Ifya ukwanshika icishiba na ukukula

Cikankala apakalamba ukulolesha pa imyanshikile nangu imipekanishishe iya ifishiba mu ukumona pa umusango uwa impanga, ukwa ukufuma amenshi na ifyo yengalakonkoloka. Ifishiba ifya ukusungilamo nangu ukutekelamo isabi fifwile fyapangwa mu inshila iifwile ukwanguka ukwisusha na ukufumyamo amenshi yonse.

Pekanyeni ifishiba fyenu pakutila fili mu milongo iya konkana;
Shininkisheni ukutila ifishiba fyenu na fi ikwatila incende shibili shibili isha icila cishiba ifya ukubomfya pa kwisushamo na ukufumya nangu ukukamika amenshi;
• Ukupekanya ifishiba mu imilongo iya konkana kulenga cila icishiba uku ikwatila icine umwa ukwisushisha na ukufumya amenshi.

1. Ukulondolola pa Ifitekwa na Ifilimwa ifya mu Menshi:

Ukulondolola pa ifitekwa na ifilimwa ifya mu menshi kutila bulimi ubwa ifi ifintu. Mu Zambia, ubulimi bwine bwine bwa ukuteeka nangu ukusunga isabi, ilyo iliteekwa nangu ukusungilwa mu nshila isha lekana lekana pamo nga mu fishiba na amatanki. Ubu ubulimi kuti bwa citwa ku mulundu nangu mu ifishiba ifya amenshi ifi sha cingililwa.
Ubulimi ubwa ifitekwa na ifilimwa ifya mu menshi mu Zambia:

Zambia eyaba nangu iya ukulenga mutanda (6) mu fyalo ifikalamba ifya iposa mu ubulimi ubwa isabi mu Africa. Ukwela nangu ukwikata isabi cila mwaka ukufuma mu ifishiba kwalininine pa mulu apakalamba ukufuma ku cipendo ica ubufino ubwa amatani 5,000 (Ton) mu 2005 ukufika mupepi na amatani 30,000 (Ton) mu 2016. Cibe nanguline Zambia yalikwata impendwa iikalamba iya abalimi banono baiposa mu ukusunga isabi (impendwa iicetekelwa ukufika kuli 21,500) impendwa iya isabi ilifuma kuli ili ibumba inono apakalamba. Nga icilangililo, mu 2017, aba balimi banono bafumishefye icipendo ca 13 % ica isabi [amatanifye 4,258 (Ton) ukufuma ku icipendo ica 32,896 (Ton) ica icalo. Kuli uyu umulandu, abalimi banono aba isabi tabafikilisha ukutila bengalasanga ubukumu bwine bwine ubwa ukusunga isabi.
Bushe fintu nshi fyakuma ku kucingilisha abalimi banono abe isabi mu Zambia?
• Ukubulilwa nangu ukukana sangwa kwa mbuto shine shine pamofye na ifilyo mupepi na abalimi;
• Umutengo uukalamba uwa ukushitilapo ifilyo fine fine ifya pwililika;
• Ukucepelwa ukwa ukusanga ubwafwilisho mu imifuntwile iya iyi imilimo;
• Ukukana kwata ukwakufumya amaka yene yene mu indalama;
• Ukukana kwata amaka ayakutwala ififuma mu maka yabo ku fisankano nangu imishika iya pa mulu;
Ifikulwa nangu imilimo iishafikapo bwino bwino;
• Ukubomfya inshila isha imitungulwile iya imilimo iishafikapo.
Ubusuma ubwa ubulimi nangu ukusunga isabi
Kusangula ku kufusha na ukusunga ifya kulya elyo na ukwafwa abalimi nangu abasunga isabi ukukwata ifya ukulya fyabo ifyalekana lekana;
Isabi likankala apakalamba ico mwaba ifya ukuwamina umubili pamo nga‘Vitamini A’ (isabi linono). ‘Vitamini A’ yalikwata ifintu ifingi ifiwamina ubumi ubwa umuntu;
Isabi likankala apakalamba ico mulafuma ama ‘proteni’ aya ku nama;

Imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi imo imo yalikwatisha ifya amafuta yetwa nangu ukwishibikwa nga ‘Omega3’, iyo iyafwilisha apakalamba mu ukubwesesha panshi ukufimba pamofye na ukucefya ifya amafuta yamo yamo ayabi mu mulopa;
Kulenga isabi ukulasangwa mu ncende umo umushaba isabi;
Kwafwa ukufusha incito na ukupeela ishuko ilya imilimo imbi iyalekana lekana;
Ilyo impanga yasangwa iishayana nangu ukulinga ukubyalamo ifilimwa, iyi inshila ilabomfiwa mu ku isumbula;

Ilaba ni inshila, ku mbali shonse shibili isha abaume na abanakashi iya abalimi banono umwa ukusangila ubukumu ubo ubwinga fuluma na ukufuluma kuli abo abekala mu incende isha mu mishi abashili balimi.

Imisango iya isabi ilisangwa mu Zambia yalilekana apakalamba ku umulandu uwa inshila li sandulukilamo na imilile. Limo pamo nga ama ‘substrate spawners’ (libikila amani ku masumbu, ku filimwa nangu ifitwala mu imimana nangufye mu menshi na fimbi), elyo na ukucingilila aya amani, lyaba mwi ibumba ilya ishibikwa nga ‘Genus Coptodon’, pamo nga icilangililo isabi ilya ishibikwa nga ‘Coptodon Rendalli (impende). Elyo ibumba limbi lintu libikila amani ukupitila ku kanwa ilya ishibikwa pamo nga ‘Oreochromis Macrochir’ (pale nangu inkamba).

3. Ukusalanganishiwa ukwa Imisango nangu Imitundu iya Suminishiwa mu Incende iya Imisumba iya Imiputule iya Luapula na Northern
Ukutantikwa ukwa imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi pe samba eyasuminishiwa ukusungwa nangu ukutekwa mu imisumba iyalekana lekana iya imiputule iya Luapula na Northern.

Umutundu uwe sabi Ishina lya Cikaya Incende nangu imisumba Oreochromis Pale, Inkamba, Chambo Imisumba yonse mu muputule Macrochir (Green- uwa Luapula ilyo mu Northern headed bream) kufumyako imisumba iya Mpulungu,Mbala na Nsama. Coptodon Rendalli Impende, Pende, Mbufu Imisumba yonse mu muputule (Red-breasted bream) uwa Luapula ilyo mu Northern kufumyako imisumba iya Mpulungu,Mbala na Nsama. Oreochromis Tanganicae Impende Isangwafye mu umuputule uwa (Tanganyika bream) Northern na imisumba iya Mpulungu, Mbala na Nsama. Clarius Gariepinus Imilonge, Lindombe, Mu- Mu imiputule yonse ibili iya (Catfish) lamba Luapula na Northern.
Ngacakuti ndefwaya ukulasunga nangu ukulateeka isabi nangu imisango imbi iipya, mulandu nshi nshinga suminishiwa?

Kwaliba imilandu iyingi iicingilisha ifi. Ica kubalilapofye li funde (Fisheries Act ilya ukulenga 22 ilya mu 2011), umo abalimi nangu abasunga isabi, basuminishiwafye ukusunga imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi likaya ilisangwa mu incende isho. Ukubika nangu ukutendeka na imisango iipya iya Tilapia muli ifi ifishiba nangu imimana kuti kwaleta amasakamiko ayakalamba ayo ayengonaula imisango imbi iya cikaya muli iyi imimana nangu ifishiba. Nga icilangililo, ilyo imisango ipya nangu iyeni iya isabi yaletwa nangu ukusokololwa muli iyi imimana nangu ifishiba, ici kuti calenga ukusandana ukwa imisango nangu imitundu iya cikaya abekashi ba isho incende bashintililapo, ukubwelela pe samba ku milandu:
Imisango nangu imitundu iipya iyo iingaletwa muli isho incende kuti nomba yalacimfyanya na iine iya cikaya mufya kulya na umwakwikala:
2. Ukulakumana pakati aka imisango nangu imitundu iipya na iya cikaya kuti nomba kwabapo na ukutinya ukonaula apakalamba ubukankala ubwa imbuto nangu isabi ilya cikaya.

Ukuya kulasandana bwangu ukwa isabi mu mumana uwa Kafue kwa isaba nkuma na ukonaika ukwa inika iya Kafue Flats Fishery (source (intulo) Kafue River Trust http://www.kafuerivertrust.org/ invasive-alien-species/).

Kuti na esha ukutungulula ukusandana ukwa iyi imisango nangu imitundu iipya mu ifishiba fyandi, eico tekuti kwingaba nangu kumo ukusakamana ukwa ukusankanya iyi imisango na imisango iya isabi ilya cikaya.

Kulaba ukusakamana inshita yonse ukwa ukutila isabi kuti lya fuma. Nga icilangililo, musango uwa isabi ilya letelwe mu ifishiba ifya mumana uwa Kafue pakati aka imyaka iya 1982 ukufika ku 1988. Isabi limo lyali fumine muli ifi ifishiba na ukutendeka ukulasandana na isabi ilya cikaya mu ululamba ulwa umumana wa Kafue. Abalondo aba isabi mu umumana uwa Kafue nomba basosa ukutila isabi ilingi bekata lya Nile Tilapia ukucila
pa ilya cikaya ilya Three-spot na Green-headed bream (Source [intulo] Kafue River Trust http://www. kafuerivertrust.org/invasive-alien-species/). Isabi ilya cikaya lyena nomba lileya lilecepelako.
Mu icintubwingi njikalila, cintu icakosa apakalamba ukusanga imbuto iya isabi. Ngacakutila ndefwaya ukushita imbuto ukufuma ku umusumba umbi, fintu nshi ninga cita?

Insambu ukufuma ku ciputulwa ica Department of Fisheries (DoF) ilafwaikwa pa ukusesha nangu ukutwala isabi ilituntulu ukufuma ku cifulo cimo ukuya kuli cimbi. Imyenseshe iya isabi pakati aka imisumba mu ukuya lisungila mu ifishiba fimbi, kufwile ukucitwafye panuma iyakupoka insambu ukupitila mu mapepala ayalembwa ukufuma ku babomfi aba mu DoF abangalila nangu ukulolesha pa imisungile iya isabi na abalimi banono. Ici cikankala apakalamba pa mulandu uwakutila muli iyi inshila kuti kwaba ukusungilila imisango nangu imitundu iya isabi ilya cikaya ilyo ilyaba mu ifishiba nangu amenshi aya kuli iyo incende.
Bushe kuti naishiba shani ukutila umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ndefwaya euyo uwingayana nangu ukulinga na incende nabelako?
Pa umulandu uwa ifilondolwelwe kale, isabi ilya cikaya elya seka na ukutemwikwa. Ipusheni nangu ukulanshanya na aba mu ciputulwa ica DoF, ngacakutila muli na amasakamiko nangu ukutwishika.

• Nga cakutila mulefwaya ukulasunga isabi ilya ukushitisha, tala moneni nangu ukufwailisha ngacakutila uyo umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi mulefwaya ulakabilwa nangu ukufwaikwa apakalamba uko konse muli na ukulatwala.
Bushe fintu nshi fimbi mfwile naloleshapo nangu ukufwailisha ilyo ndefwaya ukusala umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ndefwaya ukula sunga?
Lolekesheni pa inshita iya imikulile iya umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi. Nga cakuti mulefwaya ukuiposa mu ukuteka isabi ilya ukushitisha, umusango nangu umutundu ufwile ukuba ni uyo uukula bwangu;

• Umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ufwile ukuba ni uyo uupilibula bwangu ifilyo ifya isabi pa ukulasangamo ifya ukulya (ifyo ifipangwa mu bwingi ubwa fiko na ukula shitishiwa nangu ifipangwafye pa mayanda);

• Umusango nangu umutundu uwe sabi ufwile ukuba ni uyo uusanga bwangu ifya ukulya mu icishiba lisungilwa, nga icilangililo ‘plankton’, iyo iyaba icakulya icisangwa pa inshita iya ukubika umufundo mu cishiba mwine;
Tontonkanyeni apakalamba pa ukusunga isabi ilya kunkuma nangu ukukosa ku amalwele ayengi;
• Nga cakutila musunga isabi ilya imisango nangu imitundu iyalekana lekana mu icishiba cimo cine, moneni ukutila mwasala ilishilya isabi libiye. Pamo nga icilangililo, imilonge ilalya isabi limbi;
• Moneni ukutila mwa tontonkanishisha pa ukufwaya nangu ukusanga imbuto iisuma iya ukupyanikisha pa iilefumapo.
Sanz
Isabi ilyo ilikabilwa apakalamba nga umunani;
Ilyo mulesunga isabi ilya ukulya mu ifishiba, tontonkanyeni pa ukusunga isabi ilyo ilisandana mu ukwangufyanya muli ifi ifishiba;
Ilyo muletontonkanya pa ukusunga nangu ukuteka isabi ilya ukushitisha, tontonkanyeni pa isabi ilyo ilikabilwa apakalamba pa imishika kabili ilisha fulisha ifya kubomfya nangu ukucita cita.
4. Ukusala Incende apa Ukwimbila Icishiba ica Isabi
Pa ukusala incende apa ukwimbila icishiba, tala tontonkanyeni pali ifi ifyakonkapo:

Ukwa ukufumya amenshi ukwacetekelwa: Intulo iya amenshi ifwile ukuba iya umwaka onse kabili iishinga kwata finkolwa nkolwa ifili fyonse. Nga cingayana, intulo iya amenshi ifwile ukuba iya imako nangu ku mulundu panono pakutila kwaba ukucefyanyako indalama isha ukuposa pa ukula pompela amenshi aya ukulaisusha icishiba ico ayene kuti yale pongolokelamofye.

Umusango ufwile ukubelamo amenshi: Icikabilila nangu ukutalala ukwa amenshi kufwile ukuba ukwayana na umusango nangu umutundu uwa isabi ilili na ukula sungwamo. Umusango nangu umutundu uwa Tilapia, wena ukula bwino mu menshi ayaba pakati aka 24C na 32C. Impende (Tanganyika Bream), shena tashikula bwino mu menshi ayatalala.

Esheni ukufwaya incende iya icikabilila apo mwingembila icishiba cakusungilamo isabi elyo kabili iyi incende ipalamana na ifimuti nangu ifimpukusa, ifyo fingala cingilisha amenshi ku kasuba na ukubwesesha panshi icikabilila ica amenshi. Tilapia isandana bwino, mu ifishiba ifya pa mbilibili umo amenshi yaba cila inshita aya cikabilila.
Pa ukusunga icishiba cenu ica amenshi aya cikabilila citeni ifi ifya konkapo:
Sungeni amenshi mu cishiba ayashili ayakwenda nangu ukulasuma;
Lundenipo amenshi ayashabikwamo ifili fyonse ngacakutila yabwelela pe samba ilya 15 cm nangu ukucilapo;

• Ukushika ukwa icishiba kufwile ukuba 1 m. Ukushika nangu ukwimba ukwa icishiba kufwile ukuba pakati aka 1.2 - 1.3 m kwi samba ilyo ku mulundu kufwile ukuba pakati aka 0.6 - 0.8 m ukulinganafye na ubukulu ubwa icishiba. Ifishiba ifikalamba nafyo fimbwa nangu ukupangwa mu inshila imo ine ukulingafye na ubukulu ubwa fiko.
• Mulandu nshi mufwile mwaleukila icishiba cenu icisha shika ukufikapo: Amenshi ayashaya patali yalaluka inshita ishingi ukulingana na ifili inshita nangu ubushiku;
• Ifishiba ifisha shika filenga ifyuni ifikalamba pamo nga ‘ama Marabou’ ukulaikata na ukulya isabi. Ifishiba ifya fikapo mu ukushika, filenga isabi ukulasanga umwa ukufisama ilyo lya sanswa;

Icishibisho ku basunga amani: Ifishiba ifisha shika kuti fya bomba bwino mu uku totesha amani aya isabi. Ifishiba ifisha shika filenga amenshi ukuba aya cikabilila. Ni ici icikabilila iciwamina ukukula ukwa isabi.

• Mu ukusandana ukwa amani ukucilisha mu incende isha ‘hapa-based hatchery’. TE CAKWESHA ukubomfya ifishiba ifisha shika. Ilyo kwaba ukupekanya bwino bwino, ama ‘hapa’ tayafwile ukwikala nangu ukubela panshi nangu pe samba ilya icishiba. Ama ‘hapa’ yafwile ukupekanishiwa ukufuma panshi aya icishiba 10 - 15 ama senti mita ‘cm’. Ifishiba ifya shika filenga ukutila ama ‘hapa’ yakwate amenshi ayalinga kabili na pe samba napo apasuma.Apo casangwa ukuyana na incende iya impanga, pangeni icishiba icingakwata incende isha suluka; Icikabilila ica amenshi cili na ukuba ica cila mu mbali ukucila pa incende shimbi pa umulandu uwa ukusuluka na ukubela pa mulu.

• Apo casangwa ukuyana na incende iya impanga, pangeni icishiba icingakwata incende isha suluka; Icikabilila ica amenshi cili na ukuba ica cila mu mbali ukucila pa incende shimbi pa umulandu uwa ukusuluka na ukubela pa mulu.

Umusango uwa umushili uwayana: Icishiba cifwile ukukwata umushili uwa ibumba ico umushili uwa ibumba kuti waikata amenshi. Umushili uwa mucanga mucanga tawa wama pantu imbali isha icishiba kuti shilelikwa mu ukwa ngufyanya, na ukuleka amenshi ukulasuma.
Saleni incende iyasuluka bwino: Pangeni icishiba pa incende nangu impanga iyasuluka bwino bwino apo cingala anguka ukwisusha na ukufumya amenshi bwino mu inshita iya kula pompelamo nangu
ukupompa pa ukufumya. Incende isha sulukisha ta shayana nangu ukulinga ku fishiba pantu umushili ulasendwa bwangu.

Incende iya cifulo ica cishiba ifwile ukuba iya anguka ukufikako: Na abene abalimi ukufuma pa ng’anda mukwangukilwa ukwangalila icishiba (pamo nga ukulisha na cila inshita ukumona ifilecitika ku isabi) elyofye na ukula lisopa. Kabili icishiba cine cifwile ca angukilwa ukufikako mu ukubomfya imisebo iya ukucisuntinkanya na ku fisankano nangu imishika pamofye na ukulatwalako ifilefwaikwa.

Saleni incende isho ishi shi bunda: Ici cilafwa apakalamba ukucefya ukuposa indalama ishingi pa ukulapyanikishapo isabi ilyo ilingalasendwa na amenshi panuma iya ukubunda. Ukuleuka impanga iibunda kabili kwafwilisha amenshi aya mu cishiba ukukana suntinkana na amenshi ayamu mushili.
Ine ndi mulimi umupya elyo kuti natemwa ukuiposa mu bulimi ubwa isabi. Fintu nshi ninga cita?

Ukucingilila ukucita ifilubo na amasakamiko yambi aya ku ntanshi, tandalileni iofeshi ilya aba bomfi ba mu ciputulwa ica DoF pa kuya mupandako amano aya ukusala icifulo icingalinga ukwimbilapo icishiba. Abalimi tabafwile ukuiposa mufya imilimo iya ukusunga isabi ukwabula ukwipusha nangu ukupoka amano ukufuma kuba buteeko ubwa cikaya pamofye naba bomfi aba mu ciputulwa ica DoF.
Ndefwaya ukuiposa mu ubulimi ubwa isabi, lelo incende yandi ya menshi menshi. Fintu nshi ninga cita?
Twapapata belengeni ipepala ilyo tupekenye mu ukwasuka ubwipusho bwenu.
Ni inshila nshi iya angukisha kabili iya ukuposapo indalama ishinono ninga bomfya pa ukumona nga cakuti umusango uwa umushili kuti walinga ku ukupanga icishiba?
Kwaliba inshila shitatu isho imwe mwinga bomfya:
1. Inshila iya ukutinika iloba:
a. Bomfyeni iloba ilya linga na amenshi pakutila lya bombafye ukulinga;
b. Tinikeni na amaaka ili iloba mu minwe yenu;
c. Ngacakutila lyashala nalikatana panuma iya ukwisula iminwe yenu, ninshi ili iloba lisuma ukupangilako icishiba;
2. Iloba mu mwela:
a. Bomfyeni iloba elyo na ukupanga nga umupila; b. Poseni mu mwela elyo kabili mu lyanke nangu ukulikata
c. Nga cakutila uyu umupila wa ikatana bwino bwino uwine, ninshi ili iloba lisuma uku pangilako icishiba;
d. Nga cakuti wa bongoloka nangu wa salangana, ninshi uyu umushili tauli uwa ukupangilako icishiba;
3. Ukwesha ifyo amenshi yengila mu mushili:
a. Imbeni icilindi icingalepa mita imo (1 m) mu mushili. Isusheni ici icilindi na amenshi ukufikafye napa milomo. Kupikeni pali ici icilindi na amabula;

b. Ubushiku ubwa konkapo amenshi mu cilindi yali na ukubwelela pe samba ku umulanduuwakutila ninshi umushili na onka amenshi. Isusheni kabili ici icilindi na amenshi ukufika pa milomo na uku kupikapo na amabula;

c. Ubushiku ubwakonkapo, lolesheni apa pelelele amenshi. Ngacakutila amenshi yacili na yesula, umushili ninshi untu walinga ukupangapo icishiba. Ngacakutila amenshi na yengila, ninshi tauli uwalinga ku cishiba ica ukutekelamo isabi.
5. Inshila Ishisuma isha Ukubombelamo mu Incende isha Nika Nika
Ukupanga icishiba cenu mu incende iya inika nika kwaba na ifya kusakamika ifingi. Nga icilangililo:

a) Muli na ukufilwa ukukamika amenshi mu cishiba cenu mu inshita iya ukusombola na ukuwamya ici icishiba. Cikankala apakalamba ukukamika icishiba conse pa ukusombola isabi lyonse ukucilisha nga mwaba mu umulimo uwa ukushitisha isabi nga ubukwebo;
b) Kuti mwa lusa isabi lyenu lyonse mu cishiba ilyo ca bunda sana sana mu inshita iya mainsa;
c) Ukupanga icishiba kuti kwa kosa apakalamba ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi mu inshita iya mainsa nangu incende intu yakwatisha amenshi;

d) Ukutungulula umusango uwa amenshi na ukwa ukuya nangu ukulola kulakosa, nga icilangililo ukukusha nangu ukufusha ifya ukulya ifya cikaya ifisangwafye mu ifishiba ifya uyu umusango (Plankton) kuli na ukuba ukwa kosa apakalamba ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi ukufuma mu mushili;
e) Natulanshanya kale pa amasakamiko yamo yamo aya incende ukubikapofye na ukwingililwa ukwa amenshi aya mu cishiba kuya kufumafye mukati aka umushili.
Lelo, ngacakutila mulefwaisha apakalamba ukupanga icishiba mu incende iya uyu umusango, kwaliba inshila shimo shimo umwa ukusengulwila aya amasakamiko ayaseeka:

Kusheni ubutali na ubukulu ubwa icibumbili ica icishiba pa ukucingilila ukwisulila na ukupala ukwa amenshi mu inshita iya amainsa, kabili ubukulu ubwa icishiba bubwesesha panuma nangu ukucingilila ukusuma ukwa amenshi ukufuma mu icishiba cimo ukuya muli cimbi;

• Ukubomfya imipaipi iya utunwa tukulu kuti kwa afwilisha apakalamba ukufumya amenshi ayacila mu cipimo; amenshi ayacila mu cipimo ngata yasempwilwe nangu ukufwampulwa, kuti yalenga nangu ukutwala ifibumbili ifya icishiba ku ukutobeka na ukubongoloka.
Pe samba ni inshila shimo ishayana apakalamba isho mwingakonka mu ukupanga na ukwangalila ifishiba mu incende isha nika nika nangu amenshi.
1. Incende ifwile ukukwata nangu ukuba iyacingililwa ku kweshiwa ukwa kuponenwa na ukubunda nangu ilyeshi mu inshita iya mainsa:

Ilyeshi ilyo ilipala na ukucisha mu ukwisula ukwa icishiba kutwala mu ukulufya ifya mweo ifisangwamo, ukwambukisha ifishiba na ifintu fimbi ifya kunse pamo penefye na amenshi ayakowela. Mu incende isha nika nika, ukweshiwa na ilyeshi kula cila apakalamba. Mufwile mwasala incende iyo iya kweshiwa na ilyeshi linga cepa. Ipusheni nangu fwa ilisheni ku balimi na abekashi bashinguluka iyo incende pa kwishibilapo ifingi pa mweo uwa iyo nika nika pa myaka isano iya pitapo ukulola ku kuponenwa na ilyeshi elyo napa umulandu uwa amenshi ukulasangwa.
2. Te cakwesha ukupanga icishiba pa intulo iya amenshi:
Akamfukumfuku entulo iya amenshi ukufuma mu mushili, elyo ya seka ukulasangwa mu incende isha nika nika. Imilandu ifishiba fishifwile kupangilwa pa tumfukumfuku yakutila:
a) Amenshi ayo ayapulamo yalashupa apakalamba umwa ukuyabomfesha nangu ukutwala;
b) Ifishiba kuti fyapala ku umulandu uwa ukufulisha ukwa amenshi;
c) Ukulufya isabi ku mulandu uwa ilyeshi;

d) Ifya ukufuma mu ifya ukulya ifya cishiba fili na ukuba ifya shupa ukusanga pa mulandu uwakutila ifintu ifyo fifumako fili na ukukosa ukufisanga ico amenshi yalepitililafye cila inshita. Lelo, bomfyeni amenshi aya mu kamfukumfuku pamo nga entuntuko ayakwingila mu icishiba. Mu ncende isha nika nika na amasakamiko aya kucepelwa na amenshi, icishiba ica ukusunga amenshi pa mbali kuti capangwa mupepifye na kamfukumfuku, umo ukufuma muli ici icishiba amenshi kuti nomba yaleya mu fishiba ifya isabi.
3. Incende shifwile ukucingililwa ku kubunda:

Ku umulandu uwakutila ukweshiwa mu kupalilwa amenshi ku kalamba, ifibumbili ifya fishiba fifwile ukusumbulwa nga cinganguka. Ifishiba fifwile ukukwata ifibumbili ifitali na imipaipi iya tunwa tukulu iya ukusuminisha umwa ukupalila amenshi ilyo ya isula. Mu inshita iya ukukwatafye inshila imo iya umupaipi uwa ukusumunwinamo amenshi nga yafulisha, ifishiba mu incende isha fulisha amenshi, kuti fyakwata imipaipi iyingi umwa ukufumisha amenshi.

4. Mwi panga ifishiba mu incende isha nika nika isho isha cingililwa nangu isha tefya:

Incende isha nika nika sha senda iciputulwa ica Zambia ica cetekelwa ukufika kuli 19%. Mwaba ifishiba ifya ipangafye ifline, ifya pangwa na abantu, imilonga iya amenshi, incende isha mishitu shisulila amenshi, ifiswebebe ifya nika nika na amalungu. Incende shimo isha tefwetefwe shaliba isha cindama apakalamba kunse iya icalo, pamofye nga ba bemba ba Bangweulu, Tanganyika na Mweru-wa-Ntipa, abasangwa mu imiputule iya Northern na Luapula mu Zambia, isho kabili ni incende ishikankala umo umwinga latekelwa isabi. Imilimo iya ubulimi ubwa ifitekwa na ifilimwa ifya mu menshi kufwile ukucitwa ukwabula ukufulunganya imibele iya ishi incende. Nga icilangililo, ukucingilila incende ku kankala apakalamba ukufwile ukucitwa mu ukusungilila ubukankala ubbwa amenshi na ifisangwa mu icishiba cine (moneni pa akapepala aka kulenga mutanda nangu [6] pa inshila isha ku bomfya muli uku ukucingilila). Inshila shimbi shaba:

a. Ukupanga ukwa ifishiba ifya ukusungilamo nangu ukulaposeshamo isabi kabili ifyo ifingalasunga amenshi ukufuma mu fishiba pakutila kuleba ukusunga ifilyo nangufye fyonse ifilesangwa nangu ifilefuma mu fishiba;
b. Ukubomfya umusango uwa isabi ilya cikaya, ilyo ilishingonaula imibele iya amenshi nangu impanga;
c. Talukeni nangu lambeni ku ukubomfya ifya imiti miti, ifyo ifingalamfya ifishiba ifisunga amenshi.
6. Ifya ukwanshika icishiba na ukukula

Cikankala apakalamba ukulolesha pa imyanshikile nangu imipekanishishe iya ifishiba mu ukumona pa umusango uwa impanga, ukwa ukufuma amenshi na ifyo yengalakonkoloka. Ifishiba ifya ukusungilamo nangu ukutekelamo isabi fifwile fyapangwa mu inshila iifwile ukwanguka ukwisusha na ukufumyamo amenshi yonse.
Imipekanishishe iya icishiba:
Pekanyeni ifishiba fyenu pakutila fili mu milongo iya konkana;
Shininkisheni ukutila ifishiba fyenu na fi ikwatila incende shibili shibili isha icila cishiba ifya ukubomfya pa kwisushamo na ukufumya nangu ukukamika amenshi;
• Ukupekanya ifishiba mu imilongo iya konkana kulenga cila icishiba uku ikwatila icine umwa ukwisushisha na ukufumya amenshi.
Ifishiba tafifwile ukulapeleshanya amenshi pa ukucefyanya ukwesha ukupeleshanya amalwele elyo na pa inshita imo ine ukulasanduluka na uku ikwatila ifya ukulya ifya cikaya ifine;
• Ifishiba fifwile fyakwata ukwa ukufumya amenshi kumo kwine uko ukwingaba niku kamfukumfuku, akamana na kumbi ukwashala, (Moneni pa ifilangililo pe samba);

Pangeni nangu kuleni ifibumbili ukushinguluka icishiba pakutila ilyo amenshi yatendeka ukwingila na ukwikalila yaleba mukati aka icishiba;
• Byaleni ifyani pa mulu uwa ifibumbili pakutila fya kosa elyo na ukucingilila iloba ku kusendwa mu inshita iya mainsa;
Sungilileni na ukuposa amano ku fyani na ukuleka fileba ifyalinga;

Sungilileni icipimo ica amenshi cimo cine mu cishiba pakutila icikabilila nangu ukutalala kuleba ni kumo kwine, cingilileni ukukula kulafye ukwa ifintu mu menshi elyo na ukuleka umwela uwa ukupema mu menshi uwalinga inshita shonse;
• Moneni ukutila icishiba cenu na cikwata imipaipi apo amenshi yafwile ukulaingilila, ukufumina elyo na ukupala nga yafulisha;

• Bikeni sefa nangu umufuko umuli ifya ukususa amenshi mu imipaipi iyakwingilila, ukufumina elyo na ukupala nga yafulisha pa ukucingilila fyonse ifya ukuleta amalwele nangu ukufuma ukwa isabi. About WorldFish

WorldFish is a nonprofit research and innovation institution that creates, advances and translates scientific research on aquatic food systems into scalable solutions with transformational impact on human well-being and the environment. 1. Introduction to aquaculture:

Aquaculture is the farming of aquatic animals and plants. It can be either e land-based or open-water production. In Malawi, the principal form of aquaculture is fish farming, which is the practice of culturing fish in enclosed facilities such as ponds, tanks and cages.
1.1. Aquaculture in Malawi

Fish farming in Malawi started in 1906 with the introduction of rainbow trout (Onchorhynchus mykiss) for angling. Today, the country produces 5% of cultured fish in the region of the Southern African Development Community (SADC). Recently, Malawi has experienced growth in its aquaculture sector. Annual fish production under aquaculture increased from about 800 t in 2005 to about 4900 t in 2015 and 7672 in 2016 (CASA Malawi 2020). Malawi’s Department of Fisheries estimates that the country has 15,465 smallholder aquaculture farmers.
1.2. What are the constraints related to fish farming among smallholder farmers in Malawi?
There is a lack of availability of quality seed and feed close to smallholder farmers.
• Complete feeds are expensive to buy.
Farmers have limited access to extension support and services.
There is also a lack of financial support and access to high value markets.
Infrastructure is inadequate.
• Use of poor farm management practices is widespread.
Farmers do not have access to fast-growing fish species.
1.3. What are the benefits of aquaculture (fish farming)?
• Aquaculture contributes to food security and helps smallholder farmers diversify their diets.
Fish is an important source of micronutrients, such as vitamin A (small fish), which has a lot of health benefits.
Fish is an important source of animal protein.
Some types of fish are rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which are healthy and can lower inflammation and blood triglycerides (bad fats).
• Aquaculture makes fish available in areas where there are no capture fisheries.
It provides employment and entrepreneurship opportunities.
• When aquaculture uses land unsuitable for crop production, it improves natural resource management.
It is a source of income for both male and female smallholder farmers and generates substantial income spillover for rural non-farm households.
2. Tilapia species cultured in Malawi

(This section is adapted from Nagoli J, Pulaizi A, Unyolo S, Phiri YL, Kanthenga H, Chemula D, Mbamba D, Thidza I and Sainani H. 2020. Fish farming trainers’ guide: Pond aquaculture. Manual. Malawi: WorldFish.)
2.1. Where are tilapia found?

Tilapia, which thrives in small ponds, is now being raised in warm countries throughout Africa, Asia and the Americas. In Africa alone, there are more than 100 different types of tilapia. Each type looks and behaves slightly differently.
2.1.1. Chambo (Oreochromis karongae)

Chambo, also called chejumo, is gray and has vertical lines on its body. As a maternal mouth brooder, it incubates and broods its young in the female’s mouth. This species is considered the best option for fish farmers in Malawi. Chambo breeds successfully in ponds and grows faster than either makumba or chilinguni. It takes a while for chambo to reach sexual maturity, which means that it spends a lot of energy on growing rather than breeding. It usually becomes sexually mature when it reaches about 70 g in weight. That makes chambo ideal for the Malawi Gold Standard system, in which large fish are needed at harvest. Chambo is omnivorous. It mainly feeds on plants that naturally grow in fertilized pond water (plankton), protein-based feeds including soya and sunflower, and plant-waste products like maize and rice bran.
2.1.3. Chilunguni (Coptodon rendalli, formerly called tilapia rendalli)

Chilunguni is indigenous to Malawi and is well adapted to all water bodies in the country, though it is not widely distributed among farmers. This fish is commonly called the red-breasted tilapia, but in Malawi it is known by several local names, including chilunguni, nyungusale, katakuzi, nyakalua, mgoma mbungu and many others. Chilunguni is a substrate spawner. It is a brightly colored fish with five to seven olive vertical bars, a bright red spot on the throat and breast, and a distinct black spot on the soft dorsal rays called “the tilapia spot.” Chilunguni is herbivorous in nature (marophagous), feeding mostly on large plants.

Young and adult chilunguni are plant feeders that live in areas with plenty of vegetation. Their ability to digest aquatic plants make chilunguni especially important in combination with other tilapia species. Some of the vegetation that chilunguni feed upon includes sweet potato, cassava and papaya leaves, black jack/chisoso and elephant/napier grass. It has a high reproduction rate and produces about 5000–7000 fry per brooder and breeds about eight times each year. Chilunguni has a better growth rate than makumba because it starts breeding at a slightly older age. However, since its eggs are laid in shallow areas, the number that hatch and survive is low because many eggs and hatchlings die from high temperatures and predators.

2.3. What other fish species are cultured in Malawi?
2.3.1. Mlamba (catfish)

Mlamba can be grown successfully in combination with makumba. Combining these two species can improve the growth of each species, because the cannibalistic nature of mlamba controls the makumba population. However, mlamba is not widely accepted in Malawi for cultural and religious reasons. Mlamba is characterized by a large, flat, armored head, with no spine in the dorsal fin, and it has a long base with no scales. One of the most unique features of mlamba is its ability to breathe air, which enables it to live in extremely high population densities and produce greater yields in various culture systems.

3. Distribution of species allowed in Malawi

The Fisheries Conservation and Management Act (1997) outlines how fisheries and aquaculture are governed in Malawi. The act restricts the use of exotic species in aquaculture in order to protect Malawi’s fish biodiversity. All exotic species, including O. niloticus, are prohibited in the Lake Malawi Catchment area. The common carp (another exotic fish species) was banned in 1992.

3.1. Why am I not allowed to culture common carp or other exotic species?

There are many reasons for this. First, by law (The Fisheries Conservation and Management Act of 1997), farmers are only allowed to cultivate native species that are present in the receiving waters. Introducing exotic fish species in these water bodies can have unwanted and even dangerous consequences for the ecosystem. For example, the common carp digs up lake sediment, which could destroy tilapia breeding areas, thereby lowering tilapia reproduction by disrupted its nesting grounds (Chirwa et al. 2019).

Experience elsewhere in Africa has shown that when exotic tilapia species are introduced, this can lead to lower fish yields of the indigenous species that the local people depend on because of two reasons:
1. The exotic strains might compete with indigenous species for food, breeding sites and habitats.
2. Hybridization with closely related species might occur, threatening the genetic purity and integrity of indigenous species.
4.Site selection for earthen fishponds
4.1. How do I select a site for my fishpond?
4.1.1. Reliable water source

Make sure the water source is available year-round and free from contaminants. If possible, it should be slightly higher than the pond to reduce the energy costs of pumping water, since you can use gravity to fill the pond with water.
4.1.2. Water temperature

Make sure that the water temperature is suitable for optimal growth of the cultured species. For most tilapia species, the optimal temperature is between 24°C and 32°C. Tanganyika bream, for example, do not tolerate cold temperatures.
4.1.3. Warm area

Try to find the warmest area you can for building fishponds, and keep the area free from trees and shrubs. These limit the amount of sunlight that can penetrate the water, which lowers the temperature. Tilapia thrives in open, sunny locations where the water temperature is warm.
4.1.4. Pond maintenance
Follow these procedures to maintain your pond:
Keep the pond water stagnant.
• Add fresh water only when the level drops 15 cm or more.

• On average, maintain the pond depth at 1 m. The deep end can be up to 1.2–1.3 m deep and the shallow end 0.6–0.8 m, depending on the size of the pond. Bigger ponds are constructed deeper with corresponding wider banks/dikes.

• Avoid building a shallow pond. Shallow water is more sensitive to changes in temperature. Shallow grow- out ponds are also susceptible to invasion from big birds, like Marabou storks, which can wade through the ponds and eat the fish. A moderate pond depth allows fish to escape in case of predators.

• For hatcheries, shallow depths could work well in pond-based hatchery systems. The shallower the depth, the warmer the water temperature, and warmth is good for fish reproduction. For hapa-based hatchery systems, DO NOT use shallow ponds. When properly set up, hapas should not sit at the bottom of the pond. Set hapas 10–15 cm from the bottom. Deeper ponds ensure that hapas have enough water and good depth.
• Where topography of the land permits, build a pond with inside slopes. The temperature of the water on the inside slopes will be warmer than the rest of the pond because the slope area is shallow.
4.1.5. Suitable soil type
The pond must have clay soil because clay soil can hold water. Sandy soil is not ideal because the pond banks will erode easily, and water will leak through the pond bottom.
4.1.6. Gentle slope
Build your pond on land with a gentle slope where it is possible to fill and drain the water using gravity instead
of pumping water in and out, which can be costly. Steep slopes can erode quickly and are not good for ponds.
4.1.7. Accessibility

Make sure the pond site is accessible to your home for security as well as easy management, such as feeding and checking on fish regularly. The pond should also be easily accessible by road to ensure easy links to fish markets and inputs.
4.1.8. Flooding

Choose areas that are not flood-prone. This helps reduce any long-term costs related to replacing escaped stock after floods. Avoiding flood-prone land also prevents pond water from seeping into groundwater supplies.
4.2. I am a new farmer and would like to take up fish farming. What should I do?

To avoid mistakes and future problems, visit your local DOF officers for advice on selecting a suitable area to build a pond. Farmers should not engage in aquaculture activities without consulting local authorities and DOF officers.

4.3. What is the easiest and cheapest method I can use to check if my soil type is appropriate for pond construction?
There are three methods that you can use:
1. Squeeze the soil
a. Wet a handful of soil with just enough water to make it moist.
b. Squeeze the soil by closing your hand firmly.
c. If it holds its shape after opening your hand, the soil is good for pond construction.
2. Throw the soil
a. Wet the soil and make a ball.
b. Throw it in the air and catch it.
If the ball holds together, the soil is good for pond construction.
If it breaks or falls apart, the soil is not for pond construction.
3. Water permeability test (for multi-day training)
a. Dig a hole 1 m deep in the ground. Fill the hole to the top with water. Cover the hole with leaves.
b. The next day, the water level will be lower because the water has saturated the soil. Refill the hole to the top and cover with leaves.
c. The next day, check the water level. If the level is still high, the soil is suitable for pond construction. If the water has disappeared, it is not suitable for fish farming.
5. Better management practices for dambo areas
5.1. Can I build a fishpond in a dambo area?
Building your pond in dambo areas has many disadvantages, such as the following:
You will not be able to drain your pond for harvesting and cleaning. It is important to drain your pond completely to harvest all the fish, especially if you are doing fish farming as a business.
You run the risk of losing your stock when it floods during the rainy season.
Building a pond is difficult when there is too much water during the rainy season or if the water table is generally high.
It is difficult to control water quality parameters, such as using fertilizer to grow plankton for natural food because of too much water from the ground.
It posses environmental risks such as pond water seeping into the groundwater.
However, if you still want to construct your pond in such an area, there are two solutions to these common problems:
Increase the height and width of the dikes (pond walls) to avoid flooding and breaking during the rainy season. Wide dikes also reduce seepage from one pond into the next.
• Use large overflow pipes to help remove excess water. If not removed, excess water can cause pond walls to break and collapse.
5.2. BMP guidelines for building and managing ponds in dambo areas
5.2.1. Make sure the site has limited flood risk in the rainy season

• Floods that exceed pond levees result in the loss of cultured animals, contamination of ponds with wild aquatic animals, and mixing of potentially poor quality floodwaters and pond waters. In dambo areas, the flood risk is high. You need to select a site where the flood risk is manageable. Consult other farmers and residents around the area on the history of the dambo in the previous 5 years in terms of flooding and water availability.
5.2.2. Do not build a pond on a spring (water source)
A spring is an underground water source that is commonly found in dambo areas. There are several reasons why you should not build a pond on a spring:
Excess water will be difficult to control.
Ponds can flood due to excess water.
Flooding can result in a loss of fish.
The results of fertilization (creation of natural food) will be difficult to attain because of the loss of nutrients from the water flowing out continuously.

Instead, use the spring as an inlet water source, and divert the water to the pond. In dambos with a water supply problem, make a reservoir pond near the source of water, such as a spring, from which water can be diverted into the fishpond.
5.2.3. Protect the site from flooding

Since flood risk is high, elevate the dikes, if necessary. Ponds should have high dikes and large overflows to accommodate high water levels. Instead of one spillway, ponds in flood-sensitive areas can have multiple spillways to allow for quick outflow of water.

5.2.4. Do not develop fishponds in ecologically sensitive wetlands

Aquatic ecosystems cover 20% of the total land area on Malawi (Government of Malawi, 2015). Aquatic ecosystems in Malawi comprise lakes, rivers, wetlands and other small water bodies. Some wetlands of international importance, such as lake Chilwa wetland, ‘which was declared a Ramsar site and a Man and Biosphere Reserve (MAB)’ has been affected by human activities and climate change, affecting the livelihoods of the thousands of people (Government of Malawi, 2015). Aquaculture activities should not disturb these areas unnecessarily. For example, biosecurity measures should be put in place to maintain the integrity of biodiversity in the natural water bodies. Some measures include the following:
• Build sedimentation or treatment ponds to hold water coming from the ponds to contain pollutants or pathogens.
• Use native fish species, which cannot disrupt the ecosystem.
• Avoid using chemicals, which can pollute the water bodies.
6. Pond layout and construction

It is very important to consider the layout of the ponds in relation to the type of land, water source and drainage. Fishponds should be designed in a way that makes them easy to fill and drain completely.
6.1. How do I arrange my ponds?
• Arrange your ponds parallel to each other.
Ensure your ponds have two bypasses to allow for independent supply and removal of water. This arrangement allows each pond to have an independent inlet and outlet channel.
• Do not allow the ponds to feed water into each other. This will reduce the risk of contamination and also maximize the results of fertilization in each pond.

6.2. What are the best management practices for pond construction and preparation?
6.2.1. Build a pond that has a suitable size and shape

The best size and shape for ponds depend on production purpose, production intensity, market schedule, harvest methods and construction cost. Rectangular ponds are the most practical to build and manage. From both a management point of view and profitability, it is recommended that smallholders in Malawi build fishponds at least 1000 m2 in size. Farmers can reach that level in one of two ways: (1) build two ponds 500 m2 each or (2) build five ponds 200 m2 each. A farmer can decide on the size of their pond depending on the financial resources and labor that are available, as well as markets.
6.2.2. Use the right pond depth

Make sure the water depth is 60–80 cm in the shallow end (about knee high) and 1.2 to 1.3 m in the deep end (about waist high). The shallow end will allow you to skim fry easily into the nursery hapa. Your pond can be deeper than this if you need to use it as a water reservoir in the dry season. Just be sure that all the water can be completely drained for harvest. It is important to smooth out the pond bottom after reaching the proper depth. This will make it easier to use nets for harvesting fish, as they will slide easily over the pond bottom. Shallow ponds can be used for pond-based hatchery systems but not for grow-out.
6.2.4. Make sure dikes have the right height and slope

Elevate the pond dike at such a level that floodwater cannot enter the pond. The best slope for the pond walls is 1 m in height for every 2 m in length. You can easily make a triangle to help build the slope at this angle. The walls should be about 30 cm above the water level. Do not go beyond this height. If the pond walls are too high, they become unstable, and high walls make it hard to work around the pond. To avoid leaks, make sure that the soil used for the dike does not contain large amounts of rocks, sand, wood or plants.

Build the dikes wide enough between ponds to avoid the risk of breaking and to provide workspace. Compact the soil often as you build the wall. After adding 30 cm of loose soil, trample on it by foot or use a rammer. You can pound it with your hoe, a heavy log or a piece of wood attached to the end of a pole. This will make the dam strong. If you do not compact the soil, it will remain loose, the wall will not be strong and the pond will not hold water.
6.2.5. Ensure that each pond has its own individual water supply and outlet
Separate inlet and outlet canals; no water flow should

be allowed from one pond to another. If necessary, treat inlet water in a reservoir or use filtration. Control the flow of water into each pond using valves or shut gates, and screen inlet water to keep out wild fish, twigs, leaves and other trash. Make sure the outlet is at the deepest end of the pond so that all the water can be drained using only gravity. The inlet and overflow pipes should be at least 15 cm above the water surface to prevent fish from escaping. To avoid blockages, regularly clean the mesh over the overflow pipe in undrainable ponds where water flows continuously. Breaking the dike instead of installing an outlet is not a good practice, because this causes erosion, will weaken the dike and is labor intensive.
6.2.6. Settle and screen effluent water
For easier harvesting, make a ditch (2 m wide) in the lowest area of the pond bottom toward the drain outlet.
6.2.7. Dry the pond between batches
When using drainable ponds, drain the water from the ponds as much as possible and then dry the pond bottom until it cracks. This helps improve soil properties and dispose of organic waste.
6.2.8. Clean the pond between batches

Ponds that can be drained completely can be sundried to kill all small organisms remaining in the pond. This should be done for a minimum of 10 days. Apply agricultural lime to increase soil pH and kill harmful organisms.
6.2.9. Maintain the pond

Check dikes for holes and fix them. Maintain the ditch by lifting mud onto them. Re-slope the dikes if necessary. Also, check the inlet and outlet canals and maintain their depth to ensure water flow.
7. Biosecurity
7.1. What is biosecurity?
Biosecurity consists of practices that
reduce the risk of introducing infectious diseases and pathogens to your fish;
• help to minimize the risk of pathogens (via fomites or water) or diseased fish from escaping or leaving your farm and spreading into natural water bodies, other farms or susceptible species;
reducing stress to animals, making them less susceptible to disease (Yanong and Erlacher-Reid 2012).
7.2. Animal management
• Make sure fish seed are healthy and free of disease. To do this, buy seeds from accredited hatcheries. If you do not know which hatcheries are accredited, please ask your DOF officer.
• To prevent the potential spread of diseases and pathogens, quarantine any newly bought seeds in a separate pond with no other fish species, and separate them from other animals.

• “Quarantine is the procedure by which an individual or population is isolated, acclimated, observed and, if necessary, treated for specific diseases before its release onto the farm or for live market sale (e.g., for grow-out or for aquarium fish stores)” (Yanong and Erlacher-Reid 2012).
7.2.1. Importance of quarantines
They protect the fish you have on your farm from potential exposure to exogenous diseases and pathogens.
They allow new fish enough time to acclimatize to their new water environment and feeding and management regime.
They give fish time to recover from the stress of handling and transportation.
7.2.2. Quarantine protocol

When you buy new fish from another hatchery, do not add them to the hapa where you are already quarantining other fish. Use a new hapa. Do not mix different batches of fish in quarantine. When you quarantine the fish, look for abnormal behavior and loss of appetite. Either could be an early sign of disease.

The length of quarantine depends on factors such as the situation, species, purpose of moving the stock and accompanying risk assessments. About 15 days to 3 months is recommended, depending on the nature of movement and associated level of risk. The nature of movement is also important, whether it is within a farm, between farms, between provinces or between countries. The health status of the facilities from where the fish were taken and received also needs consideration.

WorldFish is a nonprofit research and innovation institution that creates, advances and translates scientific research on aquatic food systems into scalable solutions with transformational impact on human well-being and the environment. Our research data, evidence and insights shape better practices, policies and investment decisions for sustainable development in low- and middle-income countries.

We have a global presence across 20 countries in Asia, Africa and the Pacific with 460 staff of 30 nationalities deployed where the greatest sustainable development challenges can be addressed through holistic aquatic food systems solutions.

Our research and innovation work spans climate change, food security and nutrition, sustainable fisheries and aquaculture, the blue economy and ocean governance, One Health, genetics and AgriTech, and it integrates evidence and perspectives on gender, youth and social inclusion. Our approach empowers people for change over the long term: research excellence and engagement with national and international partners are at the heart of our efforts to set new agendas, build capacities and support better decisionmaking on the critical issues of our times.

1. Introduction to aquaculture:

Aquaculture is the farming of aquatic animals and plants. It can be either e land-based or open-water production. In Malawi, the principal form of aquaculture is fish farming, which is the practice of culturing fish in enclosed facilities such as ponds, tanks and cages.
1.1. Aquaculture in Malawi

Fish farming in Malawi started in 1906 with the introduction of rainbow trout (Onchorhynchus mykiss) for angling. Today, the country produces 5% of cultured fish in the region of the Southern African Development Community (SADC). Recently, Malawi has experienced growth in its aquaculture sector. Annual fish production under aquaculture increased from about 800 t in 2005 to about 4900 t in 2015 and 7672 in 2016 (CASA Malawi 2020). Malawi’s Department of Fisheries estimates that the country has 15,465 smallholder aquaculture farmers.
1.2. What are the constraints related to fish farming among smallholder farmers in Malawi?
There is a lack of availability of quality seed and feed close to smallholder farmers.
• Complete feeds are expensive to buy.
Farmers have limited access to extension support and services.
There is also a lack of financial support and access to high value markets.
Infrastructure is inadequate.
• Use of poor farm management practices is widespread.
Farmers do not have access to fast-growing fish species.
1.3. What are the benefits of aquaculture (fish farming)?
• Aquaculture contributes to food security and helps smallholder farmers diversify their diets.
Fish is an important source of micronutrients, such as vitamin A (small fish), which has a lot of health benefits.
Fish is an important source of animal protein.
Some types of fish are rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which are healthy and can lower inflammation and blood triglycerides (bad fats).
• Aquaculture makes fish available in areas where there are no capture fisheries.
It provides employment and entrepreneurship opportunities.
• When aquaculture uses land unsuitable for crop production, it improves natural resource management.
It is a source of income for both male and female smallholder farmers and generates substantial income spillover for rural non-farm households.
2. Tilapia species cultured in Malawi

(This section is adapted from Nagoli J, Pulaizi A, Unyolo S, Phiri YL, Kanthenga H, Chemula D, Mbamba D, Thidza I and Sainani H. 2020. Fish farming trainers’ guide: Pond aquaculture. Manual. Malawi: WorldFish.)
2.1. Where are tilapia found?

Tilapia, which thrives in small ponds, is now being raised in warm countries throughout Africa, Asia and the Americas. In Africa alone, there are more than 100 different types of tilapia. Each type looks and behaves slightly differently.
2.1.1. Chambo (Oreochromis karongae)

Chambo, also called chejumo, is gray and has vertical lines on its body. As a maternal mouth brooder, it incubates and broods its young in the female’s mouth. This species is considered the best option for fish farmers in Malawi. Chambo breeds successfully in ponds and grows faster than either makumba or chilinguni. It takes a while for chambo to reach sexual maturity, which means that it spends a lot of energy on growing rather than breeding. It usually becomes sexually mature when it reaches about 70 g in weight. That makes chambo ideal for the Malawi Gold Standard system, in which large fish are needed at harvest. Chambo is omnivorous. It mainly feeds on plants that naturally grow in fertilized pond water (plankton), protein-based feeds including soya and sunflower, and plant-waste products like maize and rice bran.
2.1.3. Chilunguni (Coptodon rendalli, formerly called tilapia rendalli)

Chilunguni is indigenous to Malawi and is well adapted to all water bodies in the country, though it is not widely distributed among farmers. This fish is commonly called the red-breasted tilapia, but in Malawi it is known by several local names, including chilunguni, nyungusale, katakuzi, nyakalua, mgoma mbungu and many others. Chilunguni is a substrate spawner. It is a brightly colored fish with five to seven olive vertical bars, a bright red spot on the throat and breast, and a distinct black spot on the soft dorsal rays called “the tilapia spot.” Chilunguni is herbivorous in nature (marophagous), feeding mostly on large plants.

Young and adult chilunguni are plant feeders that live in areas with plenty of vegetation. Their ability to digest aquatic plants make chilunguni especially important in combination with other tilapia species. Some of the vegetation that chilunguni feed upon includes sweet potato, cassava and papaya leaves, black jack/chisoso and elephant/napier grass. It has a high reproduction rate and produces about 5000–7000 fry per brooder and breeds about eight times each year. Chilunguni has a better growth rate than makumba because it starts breeding at a slightly older age. However, since its eggs are laid in shallow areas, the number that hatch and survive is low because many eggs and hatchlings die from high temperatures and predators.

2.3. What other fish species are cultured in Malawi?
2.3.1. Mlamba (catfish)

Mlamba can be grown successfully in combination with makumba. Combining these two species can improve the growth of each species, because the cannibalistic nature of mlamba controls the makumba population. However, mlamba is not widely accepted in Malawi for cultural and religious reasons. Mlamba is characterized by a large, flat, armored head, with no spine in the dorsal fin, and it has a long base with no scales. One of the most unique features of mlamba is its ability to breathe air, which enables it to live in extremely high population densities and produce greater yields in various culture systems.

3. Distribution of species allowed in Malawi

The Fisheries Conservation and Management Act (1997) outlines how fisheries and aquaculture are governed in Malawi. The act restricts the use of exotic species in aquaculture in order to protect Malawi’s fish biodiversity. All exotic species, including O. niloticus, are prohibited in the Lake Malawi Catchment area. The common carp (another exotic fish species) was banned in 1992.

3.1. Why am I not allowed to culture common carp or other exotic species?

There are many reasons for this. First, by law (The Fisheries Conservation and Management Act of 1997), farmers are only allowed to cultivate native species that are present in the receiving waters. Introducing exotic fish species in these water bodies can have unwanted and even dangerous consequences for the ecosystem. For example, the common carp digs up lake sediment, which could destroy tilapia breeding areas, thereby lowering tilapia reproduction by disrupted its nesting grounds (Chirwa et al. 2019).

Experience elsewhere in Africa has shown that when exotic tilapia species are introduced, this can lead to lower fish yields of the indigenous species that the local people depend on because of two reasons:
1. The exotic strains might compete with indigenous species for food, breeding sites and habitats.
2. Hybridization with closely related species might occur, threatening the genetic purity and integrity of indigenous species.
4.Site selection for earthen fishponds
4.1. How do I select a site for my fishpond?
4.1.1. Reliable water source

Make sure the water source is available year-round and free from contaminants. If possible, it should be slightly higher than the pond to reduce the energy costs of pumping water, since you can use gravity to fill the pond with water.
4.1.2. Water temperature

Make sure that the water temperature is suitable for optimal growth of the cultured species. For most tilapia species, the optimal temperature is between 24°C and 32°C. Tanganyika bream, for example, do not tolerate cold temperatures.
4.1.3. Warm area

Try to find the warmest area you can for building fishponds, and keep the area free from trees and shrubs. These limit the amount of sunlight that can penetrate the water, which lowers the temperature. Tilapia thrives in open, sunny locations where the water temperature is warm.
4.1.4. Pond maintenance
Follow these procedures to maintain your pond:
Keep the pond water stagnant.
• Add fresh water only when the level drops 15 cm or more.

• On average, maintain the pond depth at 1 m. The deep end can be up to 1.2–1.3 m deep and the shallow end 0.6–0.8 m, depending on the size of the pond. Bigger ponds are constructed deeper with corresponding wider banks/dikes.

• Avoid building a shallow pond. Shallow water is more sensitive to changes in temperature. Shallow grow- out ponds are also susceptible to invasion from big birds, like Marabou storks, which can wade through the ponds and eat the fish. A moderate pond depth allows fish to escape in case of predators.

• For hatcheries, shallow depths could work well in pond-based hatchery systems. The shallower the depth, the warmer the water temperature, and warmth is good for fish reproduction. For hapa-based hatchery systems, DO NOT use shallow ponds. When properly set up, hapas should not sit at the bottom of the pond. Set hapas 10–15 cm from the bottom. Deeper ponds ensure that hapas have enough water and good depth.
• Where topography of the land permits, build a pond with inside slopes. The temperature of the water on the inside slopes will be warmer than the rest of the pond because the slope area is shallow.
4.1.5. Suitable soil type
The pond must have clay soil because clay soil can hold water. Sandy soil is not ideal because the pond banks will erode easily, and water will leak through the pond bottom.
4.1.6. Gentle slope
Build your pond on land with a gentle slope where it is possible to fill and drain the water using gravity instead
of pumping water in and out, which can be costly. Steep slopes can erode quickly and are not good for ponds.
4.1.7. Accessibility

Make sure the pond site is accessible to your home for security as well as easy management, such as feeding and checking on fish regularly. The pond should also be easily accessible by road to ensure easy links to fish markets and inputs.
4.1.8. Flooding

Choose areas that are not flood-prone. This helps reduce any long-term costs related to replacing escaped stock after floods. Avoiding flood-prone land also prevents pond water from seeping into groundwater supplies.
4.2. I am a new farmer and would like to take up fish farming. What should I do?

To avoid mistakes and future problems, visit your local DOF officers for advice on selecting a suitable area to build a pond. Farmers should not engage in aquaculture activities without consulting local authorities and DOF officers.
